title: Netlens
description: Your network at a glance: health, devices, Wi-Fi, internet, services and monitored hosts. Data: the Netlens /metrics endpoint.

panels.title: Network health
panels.description: One number for the always-on and critical devices: how reachable, fast and cool they are. 80 and up is good, below 50 is poor.

panels.title: Unknown
panels.description: Devices that nobody has marked as known yet.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: A failed scan, a failing plugin or service, or an old scan.

panels.title: Weak Wi-Fi
panels.description: Clients with a signal below -75 dBm.

panels.title: Health score by part
panels.description: Latency, loss, uptime and temperature of the counted devices, and the score they add up to.

panels.title: Weakest devices (health score)
panels.description: The devices with the lowest score. Open one in Netlens to see what holds it back.

panels.title: How well Netlens knows the devices
Airtime in use per radio
panels.description: How busy the air is around each radio. Above 80 % everything on it slows down.

panels.title: Neighbouring networks on the same channel
panels.description: Other people's networks that share the channel of one of your radios.

panels.title: Signal of Wi-Fi clients
panels.description: Every Wi-Fi client; closer to 0 is stronger.

panels.title: Radios with a quieter channel available
panels.description: Radios for which Netlens found a much quieter channel. Open the access point's Wi-Fi channels card to see which.

panels.title: Containers to check
panels.description: Unhealthy containers plus containers whose image has a newer version.
